# release-core

Implement valid_core(text) -> bool for the normal X.Y.Z version core in rule 2. This function intentionally accepts only the core, without a v prefix, pre-release, or build suffix. Match the whole input without trimming; follow the document for ASCII digits and leading zeroes. Inputs are strings; return a boolean rather than raising.

Run: `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests`.
Source: https://semver.org/ (Semantic Versioning rule 2 and the <version core> grammar).
Preserve the interface and tests. No dependencies; scratch data only in the system temporary directory.
